prompt_inputs.goal: Marathon training with carbohydrate loading for a 20-mile run scheduled at 7 AM tomorrow

solution_criteria: Meal plan totals 4000+ calories with carbohydrates comprising 60%+ of total calories
Includes pre-run meal (easily digestible carbs 2-3 hours before 7 AM run) and post-run recovery meal with protein and carbs
All meals and snacks are vegetarian and nut-free
Plan is compact and fits within 1 day with practical meal timing
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a high-endurance athlete (marathon runner) requiring 4000+ calories with carbohydrate loading emphasis and specific timing around training sessions

prompt_inputs.goal: Build muscle and increase strength through resistance training with optimal protein intake and meal timing

solution_criteria: Meal plan covers 1 full day with at least 4 meals strategically timed around training
Protein-focused with macronutrient ratios appropriate for strength athletes (approximately 2.2g protein per kg bodyweight)
Includes specific meal timing recommendations relative to resistance training sessions
Compact and concise format suitable for quick daily reference
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a strength/power athlete (weightlifter) needing protein-focused meals with specific macronutrient ratios and meal timing around resistance training

prompt_inputs.goal: Maintain energy and performance for daily training while staying within 1800 calorie limit

solution_criteria: Meal plan totals approximately 1800 calories across all meals
Includes balanced macronutrients (carbs for energy, adequate protein for recovery, healthy fats)
All meals are vegetarian and nut-free
Formatted as a compact 1-day plan with breakfast, lunch, dinner, and snack
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a weight-conscious athlete (gymnast/dancer) requiring balanced nutrition within caloric constraints while maintaining energy levels and performance
